title: LocalStorage-backed queue + feedback mode (tokens, live updates, staff call/complete)

requirements.summary: Add a frontend-only Local Storage Mode toggle that switches queue + feedback reads/writes from backend calls to versioned, namespaced localStorage with safe startup loading and empty-state recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: A single, clearly labeled toggle or configuration option exists to run queue + feedback using localStorage (instead of canister calls).
When Local Storage Mode is enabled, joining/leaving/serving queue and submitting/viewing feedback work end-to-end even if the backend actor is unavailable.
All localStorage keys are namespaced (e.g., "sqfm:") and versioned to allow future migrations.
Local data is loaded on app start and reflected in the UI without requiring a page refresh.

file_operations.description: Implement a small state hook that persists the Local Storage Mode flag in localStorage (namespaced + versioned) and exposes enable/disable + reset helpers; ensure all user-facing text is in English.

Add a versioned, namespaced localStorage utility for queue + feedback (and any required cached service metadata) with: schema version constant, key builders (e.g., "sqfm:v1:...") , JSON parsing with corruption handling (falls back to empty + returns a recoverable warning message), and a write helper that broadcasts a custom in-app event for live UI updates.

Add a clearly labeled UI control (toggle + status + reset button) for Local Storage Mode, including an in-app 'Reset local data' action; show a concise English warning that Local Storage Mode is developer-focused and uses browser storage.
Wire LocalStorageModeControl into the header area (desktop + mobile) so the toggle is always discoverable; keep existing navigation and authentication intact.

Add a Local Storage Mode switch layer so queue + feedback hooks use localStorage-backed capabilities when enabled (without changing default canister-backed behavior when disabled); integrate safe fallback behavior when the backend actor is unavailable and Local Storage Mode is enabled.

requirements.summary: Generate and persist human-friendly per-service token numbers for queue entries in Local Storage Mode and display them consistently in user and staff/admin views.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user joins a service queue in Local Storage Mode, they are assigned the next token number for that service (monotonically increasing).
The user can see their token number in the Queue page alongside their position/status.
The Admin/Staff queue table shows token numbers for entries in Local Storage Mode.
Token counters persist across reloads via localStorage (per service).

file_operations.description: Extend the localStorage schema to store per-service token counters and queue entries including token number; implement atomic-style 'next token' allocation per service and persistence using namespaced, versioned keys.
Update Local Storage Mode queue-join capability to allocate a token (per service) and store it with the queue entry; ensure the same token is returned/derived consistently on subsequent reads.
In Local Storage Mode, display the user's token number alongside their position/status; ensure the token display remains stable across reloads.
In Local Storage Mode, add a Token column (or equivalent) to the staff/admin queue table so token numbers are visible for each entry.

requirements.summary: Provide live-updating queue displays in Local Storage Mode (user status/position and staff queue list) using polling and/or storage/event-based updates with safe empty-state messaging on cleared/corrupt storage.
acceptanceCriteria: In Local Storage Mode, the Queue page updates the displayed position/status without manual refresh (polling or event-based update is acceptable).
In Local Storage Mode, the Admin/Staff queue list updates when entries are added/served/completed/no-show/cancelled without requiring a full page reload.
If localStorage is cleared or corrupted, the UI falls back to a safe empty state with clear user-facing messaging in English.

file_operations.description: Add a lightweight change-notification mechanism for Local Storage Mode (e.g., dispatch a custom window event after writes; also handle the browser 'storage' event) and expose a helper to subscribe/unsubscribe.

For Local Storage Mode queries (queue snapshot, user queue status, feedback lists), add event-based invalidation and/or short-interval polling so UI updates without manual refresh; ensure corruption/cleared storage returns empty data plus a user-facing warning string that pages can render.

When Local Storage Mode is enabled, keep the queue status/position view live-updating via the local mode query behavior; if local storage data is missing/corrupt, render a safe empty state with clear English messaging (and keep the rest of the page usable).

When Local Storage Mode is enabled, keep the staff/admin queue list live-updating via the local mode query behavior; if local storage data is missing/corrupt, render a safe empty state with clear English messaging.

requirements.summary: In Local Storage Mode, implement staff controls to call the next waiting token and then explicitly mark that called entry as served/completed, while supporting waiting/served/cancelled/no-show statuses and correct position/status updates for users.
acceptanceCriteria: In Local Storage Mode, the Admin/Staff view can call the next customer (advances the queue by selecting the oldest waiting entry).

After calling next, staff can mark the called entry as completed/served via an explicit action (or via an equivalent flow if call-next immediately serves, then UI must clearly represent ‘served/completed’ state).
Queue entry statuses in Local Storage Mode support at least: waiting, served/completed, cancelled, no-show (matching the UI expectations).
The user’s position/status updates appropriately when entries ahead are served/completed/no-show/cancelled.

file_operations.description: Add Local Storage Mode queue mutation helpers to: find the oldest 'waiting' entry (call-next), set an entry to 'served' (explicit completion), and set statuses to 'cancelled'/'noShow' while maintaining joinedAt ordering and consistent token retention.

Implement Local Storage Mode variants for staff queue actions used by AdminPage (call-next, mark served/completed, mark no-show) and user actions (leave/cancel); ensure these operations trigger live UI updates through the local change-notification mechanism.

In Local Storage Mode, adapt the existing workflow so staff can (1) call next waiting entry and (2) explicitly mark the called entry as served/completed; keep the existing canister-backed workflow unchanged when Local Storage Mode is disabled.

In Local Storage Mode, compute and display the user's current status (waiting/served/cancelled/no-show) and position among waiting entries; ensure position/status updates when entries ahead change status.

requirements.summary: Persist feedback submissions in localStorage in Local Storage Mode (rating, optional comment, timestamp, service id) and show them in the Admin/Staff feedback list for the selected service with validation and success UI unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: In Local Storage Mode, submitting feedback stores rating (1–5), comment text, timestamp, and associated service identifier in localStorage.
The existing feedback success/receipt UI still appears after successful local submission.
In Local Storage Mode, the Admin/Staff feedback review tab lists locally stored feedback for the selected service and sorts newest-first (or clearly documented order).
Input validation remains: service required, rating required and constrained to 1–5; comment optional.

file_operations.description: Add Local Storage Mode feedback storage helpers to append submissions (service id, rating 1–5, optional comment, timestamp, and a stable user identifier string) and read back feedback by service id; keep keys namespaced + versioned.

Implement Local Storage Mode variants for submitFeedback and getServiceFeedback; preserve existing validation behavior (service required, rating 1–5) and return newest-first ordering (or sort in the consuming page).

Route feedback submission through Local Storage Mode when enabled while keeping the current success/receipt UI and validation in English; ensure submission works even if the backend actor is unavailable.
When Local Storage Mode is enabled, load and display locally stored feedback for the selected service in the existing Feedback Review tab, sorted newest-first.

requirements.summary: Add developer-facing documentation for Local Storage Mode, including localStorage keys/schema, token generation rules, status meanings, and reset instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: A documentation file is added to the repo describing Local Storage Mode behavior and data model (keys, example payloads, and status meanings).
Documentation includes steps to clear/reset local queue + feedback data from within the app UI and/or via browser devtools.

file_operations.description: Document Local Storage Mode: how to enable/disable, the versioned key namespace (e.g., "sqfm:v1:*"), queue entry schema (including token + statuses), token generation rules (per-service monotonically increasing), feedback schema, how live updates work, and how to reset via the in-app reset control and via browser devtools (all in English).
Add a brief inline hint/link-style text near the reset control that tells developers how to manually clear local data in browser devtools (English only) and references the documentation file path.
